full_inspection: All four complete native images of copy1site050 and copy2site126 were inspected. Every body line, punctuation mark, formula, underline and margin was compared, including the visibly doubled gap after dix, uneven type contours in remarquable/d’appro-, and the separate archive numbers. The body readings otherwise agree.
original_transcription_comparison: Both original transcriptions were compared in full. Their body texts agree, but both originals had compressed the visible double space after dix; the copy2 source is now corrected to match the directly observed gap already encoded in checked copy1. The remaining source differences are scan metadata and archive50/126.

entries.decision: restore the observed double space in copy2
entries.reason: The two-space gap after dix is directly visible in both lower images. The supplied copy2 source collapsed it to a normal interword space.
The inscriptions at the lower left read50 and126. No authorship attribution is made.
